meta.title: Simulated coverage of the interval conventions (R2 step 11)
meta.caption: Coverage = share of 400 synthetic histories whose 95% interval contains the true constant. Synthetic gap at start s = constant + mean of the h monthly shocks from s (the study's overlap). Block-bootstrap intervals: block = h, t(k-1) x SE. Phase-pooled: non-overlapping windows per start phase, pooled, t(min k_p - 1) x SE (the headline). 't needed' = 95th percentile of |pooled mean - truth| / SE over runs; 't used' = the t multiplier the convention applies.
